notes.title: New Objective UI & Bug Fixes Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]After the last update where I introduced the new tutorial, I felt that the [b]power objectives[/b] were still a bit underwhelming and needed clearer feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s why this update brings a [b]new UI notification system[/b]: now, when you complete a power objective, the game will show you that progress directly, making your actions feel more impactful and rewarding.[/p][p][/p][p]On top of that, I’ve also fixed two important bugs related to the switches:[/p][list][*][p]After the tutorial, it was impossible to complete the [b]switches objective[/b], this has now been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]switches monitor[/b] was always showing Yellow as Off and Red as On, regardless of the real state. This has also been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all the feedback and support, every small update helps me make Haunted Mines a better experience![/p][p]– Sergio (XereonDev)[/p]
